title: AI App Business Plan Generator
summary: Beginner-friendly business plan and technical roadmap for an AI-powered mobile app, built around a founder's existing social-platform audience.

hive.law2: Human picks — generated plans are drafts, never auto-sent

variables.name: industry_vertical
variables.label: Industry vertical
variables.placeholder: e.g. home solar and energy savings
variables.help: The market the app serves. Be specific: a niche beats a category.

variables.name: platform
variables.label: Social platform
variables.help: Where the founder already has an audience. Appears in the marketing-strategy section and the evaluation matrix.

variables.name: experience_level
variables.label: Programming experience level
options: Beginner — comfortable with no-code tools, little or no code
Intermediate — can build simple apps with help

variables.name: budget_range
variables.label: Initial budget range
variables.help: Also used as the cost ceiling in the Constraints section.

fields.name: output_language
fields.label: Output language
fields.help: English leaves the prompt untouched. Any other value adds an instruction to write the whole plan in that language.

fields.name: founder_notes
fields.label: Founder notes
fields.placeholder: Anything the consultant should know: existing products, audience demographics, geography, hard constraints…

constraints: Focus on solutions requiring minimal coding
Design for MVP launch within 90 days
